<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 375 812">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="375" height="812" fill="#000000"/>
  <g aria-label="status bar">
    <text x="18" y="17" font-family="Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <line x1="312" y1="13" x2="316" y2="13" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="312" y1="13" x2="312" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="319" y1="11" x2="319" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="326" y1="9" x2="326" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M337 12 L341 8 L345 12 M339 15 L343 11 L347 15" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="352" y="8" width="20" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <rect x="354" y="10" width="15" height="7" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="373" y="11" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="Netflix brand">
    <text x="187.5" y="63" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="27" font-weight="900" letter-spacing="2.2" fill="#E50815">NETFLIX</text>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="onboarding illustration">
    <rect x="12" y="82" width="351" height="235" rx="4" fill="#131313"/>
    <rect x="32" y="111" width="137" height="174" rx="7" fill="#1A1A1A" stroke="#585858" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="206" y="99" width="137" height="186" rx="7" fill="#1A1A1A" stroke="#585858" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="43" y="126" width="115" height="68" fill="#585858"/>
    <polygon points="48,187 81,151 101,171 118,157 153,187" fill="#737373"/>
    <circle cx="137" cy="140" r="9" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="217" y="114" width="115" height="73" fill="#585858"/>
    <polygon points="221,181 255,142 278,165 294,150 329,181" fill="#737373"/>
    <circle cx="315" cy="128" r="9" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="43" y="209" width="76" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="43" y="222" width="101" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF5C"/>
    <rect x="217" y="202" width="88" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="217" y="215" width="105" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF5C"/>
    <circle cx="187" cy="198" r="38" fill="#00000099" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polygon points="179,181 179,215 204,198" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="169" y1="247" x2="205" y2="247" stroke="#EE1520" stroke-width="4"/>
    <line x1="169" y1="255" x2="196" y2="255" stroke="#FFFFFF5C" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M170 297 C188 280 207 280 225 297" fill="none" stroke="#EE1520" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M155 304 C177 282 218 282 240 304" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF33" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="onboarding copy">
    <text x="187.5" y="366" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Watch anywhere.</text>
    <text x="187.5" y="399" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Stream on your TV, phone, tablet,</text>
    <text x="187.5" y="424" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">and computer.</text>
    <text x="187.5" y="463" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF82">Your entertainment travels with you.</text>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="page indicator">
    <circle cx="168" cy="503" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="184" cy="503" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF5C"/>
    <circle cx="200" cy="503" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF5C"/>
    <circle cx="216" cy="503" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF5C"/>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="help">
    <text x="187.5" y="552" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFFCC">Help</text>
    <line x1="174" y1="557" x2="201" y2="557" stroke="#FFFFFFCC" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="sign in button">
    <rect x="12" y="594" width="351" height="44" rx="2" fill="#EE1520"/>
    <text x="187.5" y="622" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">SIGN IN</text>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="navigation bar">
    <rect x="0" y="735" width="375" height="77" fill="#000000"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="735" x2="375" y2="735" stroke="#1A1A1A" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g transform="translate(37 748)">
      <polygon points="11,0 22,9 22,21 2,21 2,9" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF82" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <rect x="8" y="13" width="8" height="8" fill="#000000" stroke="#FFFFFF82" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <text x="12" y="39" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF82">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(124 748)">
      <circle cx="10" cy="9" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF82" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <line x1="15" y1="14" x2="21" y2="20" stroke="#FFFFFF82" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="11" y="39" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF82">Search</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(218 748)">
      <rect x="2" y="2" width="19" height="19" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF82" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <polyline points="7,12 11,16 17,8" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF82" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="11" y="39" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF82">Downloads</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(321 748)">
      <circle cx="4" cy="10" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF82"/>
      <circle cx="11" cy="10" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF82"/>
      <circle cx="18" cy="10" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF82"/>
      <text x="11" y="39" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF82">More</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
